title: Anthropic launches Claude for Legal — vertical-specific AI play
caption: Anthropic just launched Claude for Legal — a vertical play that matters more than you think. Why specialized models win. Why lawyers are the beachhead. What this means for every other vertical.

slides.headline: Why Claude just made lawyers the new beachhead

slides.title: What shipped
slides.body: Claude for Legal — a version of Claude trained and tuned specifically for legal workflows. Case research, contract review, brief drafting. Anthropic's first vertical-specific product.
Law firms already spend six figures per associate on research tools. Claude for Legal slots into existing budgets with better output than human juniors on doc review.

slides.title: Three reasons this vertical matters
bullets: High willingness to pay — law firms bill $400-$800 per hour
Clear ROI — shave 6 hours off a brief, bill the same, pocket the difference
Risk-tolerant early adopters — BigLaw innovation teams have budget and urgency

audiences.body: Associates work faster. Partners bill the same. Margin expands by 20-30% on research-heavy cases.
Vertical pricing unlocks enterprise budgets. Legal seats cost 3x consumer Claude. Moat widens.
Blueprint for healthcare, finance, real estate. Expect Claude for Medicine by Q4 2026.

slides.hook: The vertical AI land grab just started
